summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; sources login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings and in __all__, and exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, env vars, and profile-arg overrides. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed. Open point: a profile_args client_id or client_secret override would flow into env_vars because env_vars reads via get_dbt_value, which checks profile_args first; the spec does not cover this and I did not change it.
